name: Welcome and verify email
subject: Welcome to NEXG — verify your email
preheader: Your six-digit verification code expires in 30 minutes.
title: Welcome to NEXG
intro: Thanks for creating your NEXG merchant account. Enter the code below to verify your email and continue.

callout.title: Keep this code private
callout.body: NEXG will never ask you to share this code. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

ctaNote: Enter this code on the NEXG sign-up page to verify your email and continue setup.
trigger: A merchant requests email verification.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to the address being verified.
implementationNote: Design proposal. User selected a 30-minute expiry. Current local auth.email.otp_expiry is 3600 seconds; use 1800 seconds when this flow is implemented. Email confirmations are currently disabled locally.

name: Sign-in OTP
subject: 482916 is your NEXG sign-in code
preheader: Use this one-time code to sign in. It expires in 30 minutes.
title: Your sign-in code is here
intro: Use this code to sign in to your NEXG merchant account. Enter it on the page where you started signing in.

callout.title: Only you should use this code
callout.body: Do not forward or share it. If you did not request a code, ignore this email and review your account security.

ctaNote: This code can be used once.
trigger: A merchant requests a passwordless sign-in code.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to the verified sign-in address.
implementationNote: Proposed email OTP flow; the current merchant auth UI uses email/password. User selected a 30-minute expiry. Current local auth.email.otp_expiry is 3600 seconds; use 1800 seconds when email OTP is implemented.

name: Password reset
subject: Reset your NEXG password
preheader: You requested a password reset. Choose a new password securely.
title: Reset your password
intro: We received a request to reset the password for your NEXG account. Follow the secure link to choose a new password.
ctaNote: This link is intended for the account owner only.

callout.title: Did not request this?
callout.body: You can ignore this email. Your password will stay the same unless you complete the reset.

trigger: An account owner requests password recovery.
delivery: Transactional recovery email to the account address.
implementationNote: Recovery in apps/web/components/auth/password-recovery.tsx uses an email reset link. This is a visual proposal for that message; link lifetime must come from the active auth provider.

name: Password changed
subject: Your NEXG password was changed
preheader: Review this account security change if it was not you.
title: Your password has changed
intro: The password for your NEXG account was changed. If you made this change, there is nothing else to do.

callout.title: Was this someone else?
callout.body: Open NEXG directly to recover your account, review active sessions and contact support.

trigger: The authentication service confirms a password change.
delivery: Proposed security notice to the account owner.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Requires an authoritative auth change event and a supported account recovery destination; do not trigger from an unconfirmed request.

name: New sign-in alert
subject: A new sign-in to your NEXG account
preheader: Check the device and time for this sign-in.
title: Was this you signing in?
intro: We noticed a sign-in to your NEXG merchant account from a device you have not used before.

callout.title: Do not recognise this activity?
callout.body: Open NEXG directly to review your sessions and secure your account. Contact support if you need help.

trigger: A supported security service identifies a new-device sign-in.
delivery: Proposed security notice to the account owner.
implementationNote: Design proposal. New-device detection and session review capability must be implemented before enabling this notice. Do not infer reliable location from an IP address.

name: Confirm email change
subject: Confirm your NEXG email change
preheader: Confirm the request to update your account email address.
title: Confirm your email change
intro: You asked to change the email address on your NEXG account. Confirm this request to continue.

callout.title: Did not request this change?
callout.body: Do not confirm it. Open NEXG directly to review your account security and contact support.

ctaNote: Complete every confirmation requested by NEXG before the change takes effect.
trigger: The account owner requests an email-address change.
delivery: Proposed confirmation messages to both old and new addresses, as required by active auth settings.
implementationNote: Local supabase/config.toml has double_confirm_changes=true. Final old/new address copy and token bindings must follow the provider templates; this mockup represents the confirmation family.

name: Finish setting up
subject: Your email is verified — continue setting up NEXG
preheader: Add your business details, documents and offerings in your workspace.
title: Your business setup starts here
intro: Your email is verified. Continue setting up Karibu Kitchen so we can review the details your business needs.
steps: Add the documents requested for your business.
Set up your offerings and availability.

callout.title: Your business is not live yet
callout.body: We will show your verification and publication status in your workspace.

trigger: A merchant successfully verifies the email address used to create their account.
delivery: Proposed onboarding email to the business owner.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Account creation, business approval and publication are separate states. Required steps must adapt to the merchant profile; these steps are illustrative.

name: Application received
subject: We have your Karibu Kitchen application
preheader: You can follow the review in your merchant workspace.
title: Your application is with us
intro: We have received the business application for Karibu Kitchen. We will email you if we need more information or when the review status changes.
ctaNote: You can return to your workspace to check the latest status.
trigger: The application service confirms a complete application submission.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to the applicant and approved business recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. No universal review SLA is promised. Use the authoritative application reference and status.

name: Documents need attention
subject: A document needs updating for Karibu Kitchen
preheader: Review the reason and upload an updated document.
title: Please update this document
intro: We could not complete the review of one document for Karibu Kitchen. You can see the review note and upload a replacement in your workspace.
rows: The expiry date is not readable.

callout.title: Send documents securely
callout.body: Upload the replacement in NEXG. Please do not reply with identity or business documents attached.

trigger: A reviewer records a document issue with an actionable reason.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to authorized verification contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Document name and review reason are example data. Render only requirements actually assigned to this business; do not publish sensitive evidence in email.

name: Business approved
subject: Karibu Kitchen has been approved
preheader: Review the remaining setup before your business goes live.
title: Your business review is complete
intro: Karibu Kitchen has passed the business review. Open your workspace to check the remaining setup and publication status.

callout.title: Approval and publication are separate
callout.body: Your workspace will confirm when your business is live and available to customers.

trigger: The verification authority approves the business application.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to the owner and approved business contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Approval does not imply publication. The existing merchant.live event requires a separate live/publication notice when that transition is authoritative.

name: Application not approved
subject: An update on the Karibu Kitchen application
preheader: Review the decision and the next steps available to you.
title: We could not approve this application
intro: We have completed the review of Karibu Kitchen. The application has not been approved. Please review the decision and any available next steps in your workspace.
rows: Required business information could not be verified.
ctaNote: If you believe the information is incorrect, contact NEXG support.
trigger: A reviewer records an authoritative not-approved decision.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to the applicant and authorized business contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Show a permitted reviewer reason and only recovery or appeal options actually available; avoid implying all rejections can be resubmitted.

name: Document expiring
subject: A Karibu Kitchen document expires soon
preheader: Review and update the document before its expiry date.
title: Your document needs renewal
intro: A document on the Karibu Kitchen account is approaching its expiry date. Upload the renewed document when it is available.
ctaNote: Your workspace shows any effect this document has on your business status.
trigger: A verified required document reaches a configured expiry reminder threshold.
delivery: Proposed reminder to authorized verification contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Document requirement, expiry and reminder schedule must be authoritative; do not imply automatic suspension for every document.

name: New confirmed order
subject: New confirmed order NXG-1048
preheader: The order is confirmed. Open your workspace to start preparation.
title: A new order is ready for preparation
intro: Order NXG-1048 for Karibu Kitchen has been confirmed. Open the work details to follow the preparation and handover steps.
ctaNote: Customer details and preparation notes are available securely in your workspace.
trigger: The authoritative order and stock operation confirms an ordinary order.
delivery: Proposed opt-in work email to authorized operators; routine live work should also use the portal/push.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Automatic confirmation follows docs/merchant-portal-plan/order-confirmation.md. No Accept/Decline gate. Order total is not merchant earnings or payout entitlement.

name: Booking confirmed
subject: Booking NXG-B218 is confirmed
preheader: View the confirmed time and preparation details in NEXG.
title: A booking has been confirmed
intro: The source system has confirmed booking NXG-B218 for Karibu Kitchen. Review the time and the work details in your workspace.
ctaNote: Open the booking for customer details and any permitted service notes.
trigger: The authoritative booking operation confirms the required slot and resources.
delivery: Proposed opt-in work email to authorized booking operators.
implementationNote: Design proposal for a configured table-booking scenario. Confirmation requires an authoritative slot/resource result and does not require ordinary merchant acceptance.

name: Order or booking cancelled
subject: Order NXG-1048 has been cancelled
preheader: Review the cancellation and any remaining work in your workspace.
title: This order has been cancelled
intro: The source system has confirmed the cancellation of order NXG-1048. Review the record before taking any further preparation or handover action.

callout.title: Payment status is separate
callout.body: Open Money for any confirmed refund or adjustment linked to this order.

trigger: An authoritative order or booking cancellation is recorded.
delivery: Proposed opt-in work email to operators assigned to the affected business.
implementationNote: Design proposal. The record type, reason and allowed actions must adapt to the authoritative cancellation. Cancellation alone does not prove a refund or fee outcome.

name: New customer message
subject: A new message about order NXG-1048
preheader: Read and reply securely from your merchant workspace.
title: There is a message for your business
intro: A new customer message is waiting for Karibu Kitchen about order NXG-1048. Open NEXG to read it and reply.
ctaNote: Customer information and the message content stay in your workspace.
trigger: A permitted merchant conversation receives a new customer message.
delivery: Proposed opt-in email or digest to authorized conversation participants.
implementationNote: Design proposal. No customer identity, message body or sensitive attachments are exposed. Requires implemented conversation permissions and delivery preferences.

name: Customer payment received
subject: Payment confirmed for order NXG-1048
preheader: The payment provider has confirmed the customer payment.
title: A customer payment is confirmed
intro: The payment provider has confirmed a customer payment linked to order NXG-1048 for Karibu Kitchen.

callout.title: Payment is not a payout
callout.body: Your available merchant balance and any fees or adjustments are shown separately in Money.

trigger: A verified payment provider event confirms customer payment.
delivery: Proposed optional transaction email to explicitly authorized finance recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Customer payment, merchant entitlement, settlement and payout are separate facts. Trigger only from the payment authority, with safe deduplication.

name: Payout initiated
subject: Your KES 18,450 payout has been initiated
preheader: Follow the payout status and destination in Money.
title: Your payout is on its way
intro: The payout provider has accepted a transfer for Karibu Kitchen. You can follow its progress in Money.

callout.title: Receipt is still pending
callout.body: This notice confirms initiation. Your bank or payout provider must confirm receipt before the payout is complete.

trigger: The payout provider authoritatively accepts a transfer initiation.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to explicitly authorized payout recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. A sent or initiated payout must not be represented as received. Do not invent a bank arrival deadline or expose full payout credentials.

name: Payout failed
subject: Action needed for payout PYO-6208
preheader: Review the provider reason and supported next steps in Money.
title: Your payout could not be completed
intro: The payout provider reported that payout PYO-6208 for Karibu Kitchen failed. Review the reason and the supported next steps in Money.
rows: Destination account could not be verified.
ctaNote: Update payout details only from your secure NEXG workspace.
trigger: The payout provider confirms a failed transfer.
delivery: Proposed transactional alert to explicitly authorized payout recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Show the provider-confirmed failure and actual balance treatment. Do not promise an automatic retry, returned funds or a transfer deadline without evidence.

name: Refund processed
subject: Refund processed for order NXG-1029
preheader: The provider has processed the refund. Customer posting may still be pending.
title: The refund has been processed
intro: The payment provider has marked the refund for order NXG-1029 as processed. Review its effect on the transaction and merchant balance in Money.

callout.title: Customer posting may take longer
callout.body: Provider processing does not confirm that the customer bank or wallet has posted the refund.

trigger: The authoritative refund provider marks a refund as processed.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to authorized finance recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. ID uses the requested completed slug, but visible copy says processed. Bank or wallet posting is a separate fact; no customer receipt claim is made.

name: Statement ready
subject: Your October 2026 NEXG statement is ready
preheader: Open Money to review the statement for Karibu Kitchen.
title: Your statement is ready to review
intro: The October 2026 statement for Karibu Kitchen is ready in Money. Open the statement to review the transactions and balance movements for the period.
ctaNote: Sign in with an account that has permission to view business finances.
trigger: The statement service confirms that a scoped statement is available.
delivery: Proposed statement email to authorized finance recipients who selected this delivery.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Statement generation, scope and notification capability must exist before enabling. Do not attach unrestricted financial exports or imply every reporting action is implemented.

name: Payout details changed
subject: Payout details changed for Karibu Kitchen
preheader: Review this change to your business payout destination.
title: Your payout destination has changed
intro: An authorized change to the payout details for Karibu Kitchen was recorded. Review the destination in your secure workspace.

callout.title: Do not recognise this change?
callout.body: Open NEXG directly and contact support immediately. Review account access before making another payout change.

trigger: The payout-settings authority confirms an authenticated destination change.
delivery: Proposed security email to the owner and explicitly authorized finance/security recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Requires provider-authorized payout mapping and account permissions. Do not expose full account numbers, tokens or verification documents.

name: Team invitation
subject: You are invited to Karibu Kitchen on NEXG
preheader: Review the business and role before joining its workspace.
title: Join your team on NEXG
intro: Amina has invited you to the Karibu Kitchen merchant workspace. Review the invitation and the role before joining.
ctaNote: If you do not recognise this business or invitation, you can ignore this email.
trigger: An authorized team administrator issues an invitation.
delivery: Proposed transactional invitation to the invited address only.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Role and access scope are examples and must resolve to actual grants. Invitation acceptance, expiry and account binding must be enforced by the implemented service.

name: Team access changed
subject: Your Karibu Kitchen access has changed
preheader: Review your updated role and permissions in NEXG.
title: Your workspace access has changed
intro: An administrator updated your access to the Karibu Kitchen workspace. Your available actions now follow the permissions on your account.

callout.title: Need a different level of access?
callout.body: Contact your business administrator. A role change does not automatically authorize financial or connected-provider access.

trigger: The permissions authority confirms a team role or grant change.
delivery: Proposed transactional notice to the affected member and permitted business administrators.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Expand to added, removed or changed access only from authoritative grants. Never imply a role label grants every capability.

name: Business restricted
subject: Karibu Kitchen needs your attention
preheader: Review the account restriction and the next steps available to you.
title: Your business has been restricted
intro: A restriction has been recorded for Karibu Kitchen. Open your workspace to review what is affected and the next steps available to you.
ctaNote: You can contact NEXG support if you need help understanding the decision.
trigger: The business-status authority records a restriction, suspension or pause.
delivery: Proposed transactional notice to the owner and permitted business contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Merchant email registry includes merchant.paused, merchant.suspended and merchant.delisted. Use event-specific scope, reasons and actual appeal options; do not combine distinct status semantics in production.

name: Business access restored
subject: The restriction on Karibu Kitchen has been removed
preheader: Check the latest business and publication status in your workspace.
title: Your business access is restored
intro: The recorded restriction on Karibu Kitchen has been removed. Open your workspace to check the latest business status and any remaining setup.

callout.title: Check your publication status
callout.body: Access restoration does not by itself confirm that your business is live or that every connected service is available.

trigger: The business-status authority confirms removal of a restriction.
delivery: Proposed transactional email to the owner and permitted business contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Restored access, verification, publication and provider availability remain separate facts. A live notice requires a confirmed merchant.live transition.

name: Support request received
subject: We have your message · SUP-2468
preheader: Keep this reference if you need to follow up with NEXG support.
title: Your support request is with us
intro: We have received your message about Karibu Kitchen. A member of the NEXG support team will review it and reply using your contact details.
ctaNote: Use reference SUP-2468 if you contact info@nexgapp.com.
trigger: The support service creates a support ticket successfully.
delivery: Transactional acknowledgement to the ticket requester.
implementationNote: Existing apps/web/lib/email.ts has a plain-text ticketReceived template. This is a visual proposal. Keep any portal CTA conditional on an implemented ticket view and its permissions.

name: Support request resolved
subject: Support request SUP-2468 has been resolved
preheader: Review the update and contact support if the issue remains.
title: Your support request is resolved
intro: NEXG support has marked request SUP-2468 as resolved. Open the update to review the outcome for Karibu Kitchen.

callout.title: Still need help with this?
callout.body: Contact NEXG support and quote SUP-2468 so we can review the same request.

ctaNote: You can contact info@nexgapp.com for help.
trigger: The support service records a resolved ticket status.
delivery: Transactional support update to the ticket requester and permitted participants.
implementationNote: Existing apps/web/lib/email.ts has a plain-text ticketResolved template. This is a visual proposal. Resolution content and any authenticated portal destination require actual ticket permissions.

name: Booking updated
subject: Booking NXG-B218 has been updated
preheader: Check the confirmed booking time before preparing for the visit.
title: A booking time has changed
intro: The source system has confirmed an update to booking NXG-B218 for Karibu Kitchen. Use the latest details below when planning the visit.
ctaNote: Customer details and the complete change history are available in your workspace.
trigger: The authoritative booking service confirms a resource-valid booking change.
delivery: Proposed opt-in work email to authorized booking operators.
implementationNote: Design proposal. A requested change is not confirmed until the source validates the required resources. Preserve change history and deduplicate repeated provider events.

name: Email address changed
subject: Your NEXG account email has changed
preheader: Review this completed account change if it was not you.
title: Your account email has changed
intro: The email address for your NEXG account has been updated after the required confirmations were completed.

callout.title: Did not make this change?
callout.body: Open NEXG directly and contact support immediately. Include no passwords or verification codes in your message.

trigger: The authentication authority confirms completion of an email-address change.
delivery: Proposed security notice to the previous and current account addresses, subject to approved security policy.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Local auth requires double confirmation for changes. Send only after the authoritative change completes, and bind any recovery destination to the correct account.

name: Business is live
subject: Karibu Kitchen is live on NEXG
preheader: Your business is now published and available to customers.
title: Your business is live on NEXG
intro: Karibu Kitchen is now published on NEXG. Customers can discover your business and use the services you have made available.
ctaNote: Check your current offerings, availability and business details.
trigger: The authoritative publication service confirms a merchant.live transition.
delivery: Transactional activation notice to the owner and approved business contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal for the existing merchant.live notification family. Send only when publication is confirmed; application approval alone is insufficient.

name: Document approved
subject: Your Karibu Kitchen document has been approved
preheader: The submitted document has passed review.
title: Your document has been approved
intro: We have approved the business permit you submitted for Karibu Kitchen. Open your workspace to see the status of any remaining documents.

callout.title: Check the full application status
callout.body: Approval of this document does not confirm approval or publication of your business.

trigger: A reviewer records approval of an assigned merchant document.
delivery: Transactional review notice to authorized verification contacts.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Name the specific approved document and use the verified review result. One approved document does not imply full business verification.

name: Payout completed
subject: Payout PYO-6208 has been completed
preheader: The payout provider has confirmed a completed transfer.
title: Your payout is complete
intro: The payout provider has confirmed that transfer PYO-6208 for Karibu Kitchen is complete. Review the provider confirmation in Money.
ctaNote: Contact support with this payout reference if you need help reconciling the transfer.
trigger: A verified payout provider event confirms a terminal completed transfer status.
delivery: Transactional notice to explicitly authorized payout recipients.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Map terminal completion to the actual provider contract. Do not send from transfer initiation, internal balance movement or an unverified webhook. Recipient bank receipt can be claimed only when that is what the provider confirmation proves.

name: Support has replied
subject: A reply to support request SUP-2468
preheader: Read the support update in your secure NEXG workspace.
title: Support has replied to your request
intro: There is a new reply to your support request about Karibu Kitchen. Open the request to read the update and respond.
ctaNote: For help, contact info@nexgapp.com and quote SUP-2468.
trigger: An authorized support agent publishes a reply visible to the requester.
delivery: Transactional support reply notice to the requester and permitted participants.
implementationNote: Design proposal. Requires an authenticated ticket conversation view. Do not copy private notes, identity documents or financial attachments into the email.
